entities.summary: Denis Andreyevich Osipov, also competing as Dannisi Aoxibofu, is a former Russian-born Chinese professional ice hockey defenceman. He most recently played under contract with HC Kunlun Red Star of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He represented China at the 2022 Winter Olympics.
